Ch. 2 Phonology (pp. 14-35; pp. 29-50) gives 24 consonants, 14 vowels, 4 contrastive tones ('Kayan Lahta is a tonal language', p. 27; 'Every syllable has tone', p. 30) and a major/minor syllable split (minor = syllabic nasal or C+schwa first syllable of a disyllable, sec. 2.4.2 p. 31); no statement on word stress/accent anywhere (a full-text search for stress/accent|accent|prominence|iambic|unstressed = 0; phonology pages read).
